summary.text: Yasmin Trudeau is a member of the Washington State Senate who, in her own words on her official biography page, is the youngest state senator. The page lists her as Vice Chair of the Ways & Means Committee, leading the Senate's Capital Budget, and Vice Chair of the Law & Justice Committee.

paragraphs.text: Trudeau writes on her official page that she is a mother of two young children and has an adult brother with disabilities, and that she grew up relying on housing assistance and state support.
She writes that she is an American Muslim who grew up as a first-generation immigrant, born in Bangladesh and rooted in the Pacific Northwest.
She also writes that she got her first job for the state at age 30.
The page states her commitment to greater transparency in politics, helping the public understand how the Legislature works.
She also sits on the Housing Committee, according to the page.
